name: Point S
verdict: A network of independent tyre and car-maintenance dealers (Point S Development, Lyon), describing itself as totally independent. Nothing found.
note: Key partner of Team Peugeot TotalEnergies since 2025, renewed for 2026 (logo on the 9X8; peugeot-sport.com partner page and news of 2026-02-19). Owner chain checked: member network of independent dealers, no state or dominant outside shareholder. No human-rights finding found.
